summary: Normalize dup_mul_ground and dmp_mul_ground results with dup_strip/dmp_strip so EX coefficients that simplify to zero yield valid dense representations, including recursively multivariate polynomials. Added direct multiplication regressions for zero results, stripped leading coefficients, retained trailing zeros, and zero scalar multiplication; added Poly.clear_denoms regression covering 1-3 generators, both convert settings, is_zero/as_expr/terms_gcd/primitive. Reproduced bug using 1/(sqrt(2)+sqrt(3))+sqrt(2)-sqrt(3); new tests failed before fix (204 passed, 2 failed). After fix, public bin/test for test_densearith.py, test_densetools.py, and test_polytools.py passed all 242 tests. Inspected final diff. No full-suite or hidden tests run.
